home-overview.png.note: Agent-captured (session.js + routes.js BASE route, brand dashboard, All Selected brand view): Home > Overview tab, the default landing page. Shows the four-tab bar (Overview/Tasks/Chat/Calendar), the brand selector strip across the top, the notification inbox on the left with mixed notification types (chat mentions, invite-approval requests) each carrying a quick action link (View Chat / Review request), and the calendar sidebar on the right with a mini-month picker, a Connect Calendar prompt, and a populated upcoming-events list grouped by day. Hand cursor on the first notification's 'View Chat' quick action (clickable text, per cursor heuristic). dom-sanitize ran before the shot: 3 internal @franchisesystems.ai emails were masked to @example.com and 6 relative-time chips were freshened (1 day ago / 2 weeks ago / about 8 weeks ago) so the shot doesn't look stale. Covers the intro paragraph, the tab list, and the entire Overview tab section (inbox description, quick actions, calendar sidebar with connect-calendar prompt).

A 'Welcome to Tasks' product-tour modal appeared on first visit and a tour-interaction-blocker overlay intercepted clicks; both were dismissed via a direct DOM .click() on 'Maybe Later' (Playwright's actionability check kept finding the transparent blocker mid-transition) before waiting ~4s for the table to hydrate past its loading skeleton. Shows the real task table (Total Tasks: 1866) with Task/Linked To/Status/Responsible/Due Date/Created columns, filter/sort icons, and the '+ Create Task' button. Arrow cursor on 'Create Task' (button, per heuristic). No PII: responsible-party avatars are generic placeholder icons, task titles are generic onboarding-checklist items. Covers the Tasks tab section including the table's column set.

home-chat.png.note: Agent-captured: Home > Chat tab. home-create-quick-task.png.note: Agent-captured (session.js + routes.js BASE route, brand dashboard): Home > Tasks tab > + Create Task. Modal opens on the quick-task form (default). Task Name filled ('Follow up with new franchisee lead') for a fuller look; Description/Due Date left empty/default. The article text says 'Turn on Notify Responsible to alert the assignee', which does not match current staging UI; flagging for Max, did not alter article prose (out of scope for a capture pass). Shot is otherwise an accurate, unmodified capture of the real modal.

home-work-task-type-picker.png.note: Agent-captured: same modal, after clicking 'Turn into work task' from the Create Quick Task form. Guided flow opens on step 1 of 4, 'Pick a task type', with Todo checklist selected by default (checkmark badge). Shows all 7 type cards (Todo checklist, Form, Visit a link, Schedule a call, Watch a video, View slides, Sign a document) and the footer (Cancel / Switch back to quick task / Step 1 of 4 / Continue). The dialog itself is CSS-capped at max-height:640px with overflow:auto, and the 7-card grid is a second, independently-scrolling inner div -- both clip real, already-rendered content since 7 cards in 3 rows don't fit the allotted space. Unclipped both (style.overflow='visible', maxHeight/height='auto' via page.evaluate) before the screenshot so all 7 cards render in one shot instead of scrolling/truncating -- nothing fabricated, just un-hiding DOM that was already there. Arrow cursor on the Todo checklist card's icon (selected state).
